chapterInfo.content:
20
Mmara Nsɛm Du no
(Deuteronomium 5.1-21)
1 # Deut 5.6-21 Na Onyankopɔn kaa nsɛm yi nyinaa sɛ: 2Mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a meyii wo Misraim asase so nkoafie mu no.
3 # Deut 6.4-5; 1 Ko 8.6 Nnya anyame foforɔ nka me ho.
4 # Lew 26.1; Deut 27.15; Dwom 97.7; Yes 40.18-26; Rom 1.23 Nyɛ ohoni biara anaa adeɛ a ɛwɔ wiem wɔ soro anaa deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ wɔ fam anaa deɛ ɛwɔ nsuo mu wɔ asase ase nsɛsoɔ biara mfa; nkoto wɔn, na nsom wɔn. 5#Eks 34.7; Yer 31.29-30; Hes 18.2-3, 20 Na me, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, meyɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ a metua nananom amumuyɛ so ka mefa mma so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mmiɛnsa ne nnan a wɔtane me soɔ, 6na meyɛ mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wɔdi me mmara nsɛm soɔ adɔeɛ.
7 # Lew 24.16 Mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn din kwa, na AWURADE remma deɛ ɔbɔ ne din kwa no mfa ne ho tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
8 # Eks 16.25; Hes 20.12; Mar 2.27-28; Kol 2.16-17 Kae homeda, na yɛ no kronkron. 9Nnansia na yɛ adwuma, na yɛ w’adeɛ nyinaa; 10na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ homeda ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; nyɛ adwuma biara, wo ne wo babanin ne wo babaa, w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne wo mmoa ne wo hɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo fie apono mu. 11#Gye 2.2-3 Na nnansia na AWURADE de yɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase, ɛpo ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, na ɔhomee da a ɛtɔ so nson no; enti na AWURADE hyiraa homeda, na ɔyɛɛ no kronkron.
12 # Mat 15.4; Efe 6.2-3 Di wo na ne w’agya ni, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
13 # Eks 21.12; Gye 9.5-6; Yak 2.11 Nni awu.
14 # Lew 20.10; Efe 3.3-5 Nsɛe awadeɛ.
15 # Lew 19.11; Efe 4.28 Mmɔ korɔno.
16 # Eks 23.1; Efe 4.25 Nni wo yɔnko ho adansekurumu.
17Mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko fie. Mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko yere anaa n’akoa anaa n’afenaa anaa ne nantwie anaa n’afunumu anaa biribiara a ɛyɛ wo yɔnko dea.
Ɔman no suro
(Deuteronomium 5.22-33)
18Na ɔman no nyinaa hunuu aprannaa ne anyinam a ɛpapaeɛ ne totorobɛnto nne ne bepɔ a ɛfiri wisie no. Na ɔman no hunuiɛ no, wɔn ho popoe, na wɔkɔgyinaa akyirikyiri. 19Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo na wo ne yɛn nkasa, na yɛbɛtie; na mma Onyankopɔn ne yɛn nnkasa, na yɛanwuwu.
20Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monnsuro, na Onyankopɔn rebɛsɔ mo ahwɛ, na ne ho hu atena mo ani so, na moanyɛ bɔne. 21#Heb 12.18 Na ɔman no gyinaa akyirikyiri, na Mose twe pinii esum kabii a Onyankopɔn wɔ mu no.
Afɔremmukyea ho mmara
22Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sɛ ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ nie: Mo ara moahunu sɛ mefiri ɔsoro na me ne mo akasa. 23Monnyɛ me so dwetɛ anyame anaa sika anyame biara mmfa.
24 # Eks 27.1, 8; 29.42-43; Deut 12.5 Dɔteɛ afɔrebukyia na yɛ ma me, na ɛso na fa wo nnwan ne w’anantwie bɔ ɔhyeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. Na baabiara a mɛma wɔakae me din no, mɛba wɔn nkyɛn mabɛhyira wɔn. 25#Deut 27.5; Yos 8.31 Na sɛ worebɛyɛ aboɔ afɔrebukyia ama me a, mfa aboɔ a wɔatwa nsi; na sɛ woma w’adwinneɛ so bɔ so a, woagu ho fi. 26Na mforo atwedeɛ nkɔ m’afɔrebukyia so, na w’adagya anna adi wɔ so.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Onyankopɔn kaa nsɛm yi nyinaa sɛ: Mene AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn a meyii wo Misraim asase so nkoafie mu no.
Nnya anyame foforɔ nka me ho.
Nyɛ ohoni biara anaa adeɛ a ɛwɔ wiem wɔ soro anaa deɛ ɛwɔ asase soɔ wɔ fam anaa deɛ ɛwɔ nsuo mu wɔ asase ase nsɛsoɔ biara mfa; nkoto wɔn, na nsom wɔn. Na me, AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, meyɛ Onyankopɔn ninkufoɔ a metua nananom amumuyɛ so ka mefa mma so kɔsi awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mmiɛnsa ne nnan a wɔtane me soɔ, na meyɛ mpempem a wɔdɔ me na wɔdi me mmara nsɛm soɔ adɔeɛ.
Mmɔ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn din kwa, na AWURADE remma deɛ ɔbɔ ne din kwa no mfa ne ho tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
Kae homeda, na yɛ no kronkron. Nnansia na yɛ adwuma, na yɛ w’adeɛ nyinaa; na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ homeda ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; nyɛ adwuma biara, wo ne wo babanin ne wo babaa, w’akoa ne w’afenaa ne wo mmoa ne wo hɔhoɔ a ɔwɔ wo fie apono mu. Na nnansia na AWURADE de yɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase, ɛpo ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa, na ɔhomee da a ɛtɔ so nson no; enti na AWURADE hyiraa homeda, na ɔyɛɛ no kronkron.
Di wo na ne w’agya ni, na wo nna aware asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so.
Nni awu.
Nsɛe awadeɛ.
Mmɔ korɔno.
Nni wo yɔnko ho adansekurumu.
Mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko fie. Mma w’ani mmmere wo yɔnko yere anaa n’akoa anaa n’afenaa anaa ne nantwie anaa n’afunumu anaa biribiara a ɛyɛ wo yɔnko dea.


Na ɔman no nyinaa hunuu aprannaa ne anyinam a ɛpapaeɛ ne totorobɛnto nne ne bepɔ a ɛfiri wisie no. Na ɔman no hunuiɛ no, wɔn ho popoe, na wɔkɔgyinaa akyirikyiri. Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Wo na wo ne yɛn nkasa, na yɛbɛtie; na mma Onyankopɔn ne yɛn nnkasa, na yɛanwuwu.
Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monnsuro, na Onyankopɔn rebɛsɔ mo ahwɛ, na ne ho hu atena mo ani so, na moanyɛ bɔne. Na ɔman no gyinaa akyirikyiri, na Mose twe pinii esum kabii a Onyankopɔn wɔ mu no.

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Sɛ ka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ nie: Mo ara moahunu sɛ mefiri ɔsoro na me ne mo akasa. Monnyɛ me so dwetɛ anyame anaa sika anyame biara mmfa.
Dɔteɛ afɔrebukyia na yɛ ma me, na ɛso na fa wo nnwan ne w’anantwie bɔ ɔhyeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. Na baabiara a mɛma wɔakae me din no, mɛba wɔn nkyɛn mabɛhyira wɔn. Na sɛ worebɛyɛ aboɔ afɔrebukyia ama me a, mfa aboɔ a wɔatwa nsi; na sɛ woma w’adwinneɛ so bɔ so a, woagu ho fi. Na mforo atwedeɛ nkɔ m’afɔrebukyia so, na w’adagya anna adi wɔ so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
